title: Replace hardcoded user roles with configurable settings
summary:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

Closes #2908

---

## Summary

- Replace hardcoded role names (`platform_admin`, `platform_viewer`, `team_admin`) in `email_auth_service` with configurable settings (`DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_USER_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_TEAM_OWNER_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_TEAM_MEMBER_ROLE`)
- Add Alembic data migration to update existing `user_roles` assignments when configured roles differ from previous hardcoded defaults
- Add RBAC role assignment when team members are added/removed via `team_management_service`
- Add corresponding Helm chart values and `.env.example` documentation

## Changes

### `mcpgateway/config.py`

- Added `default_admin_role`, `default_user_role`, `default_team_owner_role`, `default_team_member_role` settings with backward-compatible defaults

### `mcpgateway/services/email_auth_service.py`

- `create_user`: Uses `settings.default_admin_role` / `settings.default_user_role` for global role and `settings.default_team_owner_role` for personal team role
- `update_user`: Uses `settings.default_admin_role` / `settings.default_user_role` for promotion/demotion logic

### `mcpgateway/services/team_management_service.py`

- Added lazy-initialized `role_service` property to avoid circular imports
- `add_member_to_team`: Assigns team-scoped RBAC role (`DEFAULT_TEAM_MEMBER_ROLE`) to new/reactivated members
- `remove_member_from_team`: Revokes team-scoped RBAC role when members are removed
- `update_member_role`: Transitions RBAC roles when membership role changes (member ↔ owner)
- `approve_join_request`: Assigns team-scoped RBAC role to approved join request members

### `mcpgateway/alembic/versions/ba202ac1665f_migrate_user_roles_to_configurable_.py`

- Data migration that updates existing `user_roles` when configured defaults differ from previous hardcoded values
- No-op when settings match old defaults (backward compatible)
- Supports both PostgreSQL and SQLite (uses Python uuid generation instead of `gen_random_uuid()`)
- Creates team-scoped roles for existing team members who don't have any

### `charts/mcp-stack/values.yaml`

- Added `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_USER_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_TEAM_OWNER_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_TEAM_MEMBER_ROLE` under new "Default Role Configuration" section

### `.env.example`

- Documented all four new environment variables with defaults

## 🧪 Verification

| Check            | Command                                                                                                                           | Status |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| Unit tests       | `pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_email_auth_service.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_team_management_service.py` | pass   |
| Migration syntax | `python -m py_compile`                                                                                                            | pass   |

## 📐 MCP Compliance (if relevant)

- [x] Matches current MCP spec
- [x] No breaking change to MCP clients

## ✅ Checklist

- [x] Code formatted
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed
- [x] Backward compatible (defaults match previous hardcoded values)
